'''Duro Shipping''' was a commercial shipping entity in existence around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], presumably based out of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]. It was counted among the ranks of other concerns such as the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].<ref name="Cloak of Deception" />
